title: Interview facecode
text:
The interview where candidates
actually write code.
Panel interviews are your most expensive hiring step.
Most teams run them on improvised tools.
Everything the interview needs.
In one session.
A code editor that evaluates
as they write.
Panel interviews and system design,
in the same room.
AI-compiled summaries.
Ready before the panel logs off.
Scheduling that doesn't create more work.
Candidate identity, protected by default.
Two modes, one session
View and switch between screens
Connection quality, visible in-session
Interviewers know what's happening as it happens
One session, one candidate
From invite to decision
in a single session.
Used by engineering teams who hire
on signal, not instinct.
Any live technical interview,
run properly.
Interviews where live code and live conversation both matter.
Situations where a live session adds friction without adding signal.
High performance,
at any scale.
Frequently asked questions about
FaceCode.
Can interviewers use their own questions, or do they have to use the HackerEarth library?
Does the candidate need to install anything before the interview?
How does the AI summary work, and who can see it?
Can we replay exactly how a candidate built their solution?
How does FaceCode integrate with our ATS?
What happens to interview data after the process ends?
Want a second opinion?
Ask AI.
Run your next technical interview
like it matters.
Multiple programming languages supported.
Candidates can solve programming questions in 40+ languages with snippets and auto-complete in each.
EEOC and OFCCP compliant
— question selection, scoring rubrics, and decision-support outputs are designed for use in regulated hiring contexts. Compliance documentation available on request.
